notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes:
We're finally ready to announce our release date! Get your setup ready, dust off those mousepads, and buy a reinforced desk because we're kicking off on the 21st of July!

To everyone who has been here since the start or joined along the way — thank you for the support! We had a ton of fun making Kick'n Hell, and we hope you enjoy playing it even more!

Now, we have 2 months left before launch. But don't worry — we'll be sharing more exciting news as we get closer to release! So be sure to follow us, join our Discord, and tell all your friends!

notes.title: One last demo update..
notes.notes:
Hi there martial artists!

We have worked hard to finalize everything inside of Kick'n Hell. We're almost ready with the full production, but we also made some changes to the demo level.

Unfortunately this meant also resetting the leaderboards, but this was probably the last time that we had to! So your time now will stay forever!

As mentioned in our last news update, we are almost ready for QA testing. Phase 1 will start very soon as we figure out the final details to make it work. If you're interested be sure to join our Discord server, as that is the only place you can get access!

notes.title: Demo update: Replays, Ranks, 3rd Ditch, ...
notes.notes:
We're back with great news! The demo has been updated with some major improvements! We have been working hard on the content for our full release, but we haven't forgotten about our demo. 

After 2 months, we thought an update was well due! So now it's here. What's new in this update? 


 RanksEvery level has it's own ranks based on time. Ranging from Apprentice to Fire Lord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/2b98402e998fdd8c8373c769aedc56a1ce68485f.gif

 A replay system + friends leaderboardsEach leaderboard entry will be connected to the replay of that players run. Everyone can battle against each entry by clicking this entry and then battling. This will make their ghost appear in your level and you will have a direct look at their path. We also added a small icon that can be clicked to just show your Steam friends. Nothing is better than beating your friends in each level right? Now you have a handy overview of just your Steam friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/4526bdf953969488eb74bb03b4f0a849b2cf76af.gif
 3rd DitchA brand new level from the Circle of Fraud makes it way into Kick'n Hell. 3rd Ditch is another level set in the grim ditches of Fraud where you will have to make your way upwards in a very vertical based level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/d0a8aca9cbcd0f2ba7d04899f72dee6529564b3f.png
 Steam remote play for hotseat!You can invite friends to play together! You can give everyone access to keyboard and mouse by using the remote play features. This is a bit chaotic because everyone has input at the same time, but we hope you can trust your friends on not ruining your run! ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/a8cebd740e4f3a28ba38133c285c5dc8a19f5f5a.gif
 Level intro's Each level has a small video that showcases the whole level. This only plays on your first play or whenever you reset the level. Quick restarting won't trigger this video. They can also be disabled in your settings.

 Key rebindingAll controls can be rebinded in the settings. We don't allow double binding, so no jumping, moving and kicking all on the same button!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/78f562ed9ab80aeae3c6b92d706b8fd2409dfd11.png
 UI improvementsOveral UI has been improved.

 Small difficulty ramping changeWe have adjusted the first few levels slightly, to make them less punishing and more fun to play. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963844/0d4d05ec38c07bdf0d2680ffea4b5c47e4a87a5c.png
If you want to playtest new levels, chat with the devs, call out people from the leaderboards or you encounter bugs one adress: our discord server! 

And if you like the game, wishlist for when we release!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832070/Kickn_Hell/

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
Greetings, martial artists!

We have been at work to improve the demo version that's online. We have some changes that we want to share with you.



 2 brand new levels! We added 2 'tutorial' levels. Let us know if these levels make you understand the game better!

 A brand new gamemode! We have added a hotseat gamemode, which allows you to play with other people locally. We would love to hear what you think of this concept and if you want to see it changed or improved in certain ways.

 Overal clarity improved. Some aspects in the game were a bit vague. The red doors for example. We have included information which levels are not included in the demo.

 Dash has been reworked! The dash that is available in the last level has been changed to keep momentum. Furthermore it is now also completely based on the direction you are looking at. So no more dashing backwards!

 The leaderboards now display more unique characters. To the players with some unique characters like an underscore, your name will now display correctly. Unfortunately we don't have support for all languages. 

 Sprint has become the default! No more worrying over pressing shift, you will run automatically now and you can slow down with pressing shift. This is handy for a small jump or for adjusting your place slightly.

 Leaderboards accessible from in-game. Check out the times of everyone from inside a level, no need to go to the main menu anymore!


We have also fixed some bugs. If you encounter new bugs, report them in the Discord server!
